story.title: AI helped Shenzhen judges handle 50% more cases in 2025 and will now expand to dozens of Chinese cities
story.summary: Judges at Shenzhen's Intermediate People's Court processed 50 percent more cases in 2025 compared to 2024, with each judge handling an average of 744 cases — up by 249 — after deploying a pilot AI-powered case management system. The court has announced the system will now be rolled out to dozens of additional Chinese cities. The development marks one of the most concrete large-scale deployments of AI in a national judicial system, raising both efficiency and due-process questions.
